case_material_1.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Draw ONE isolated Rhodes Island MATERIAL STORAGE CASE TIER 1 as a painted 2D game inventory icon. Square composition, true transparent alpha background. Match a bold-outline flat-color ARPG icon style: thick dark charcoal contour, clean hand-painted broad local color regions and simple material highlights, no color-count limit. Not a product photo or photoreal render. Slight 3/4 top-front view showing front, right side and a little top, upper-left light.
Object: one compact squat charcoal-dark-gray CANVAS storage box with a rigid dark metal external frame. Clearly soft canvas panels with 2 or 3 simple folds, fabric texture suggested minimally, reinforced frame edges. ONE wide AMBER ORANGE strap wraps vertically around the entire box (over lid and down front), with ONE central metal clasp. On the front a single clean large pale BOLT / HEX BOLT emblem identifies materials. A small subtle white Rhodes Island tower mark on side is acceptable; no lettering. This is a modest field storage box, not ornate treasure chest. No wheels, no metal corner guards, no padlock hanging off it, no loose contents. Whole case visible with 8% clear margin on all sides. Bold readable at 72x72 final pixels. Only the box, no scene, floor, external drop shadow, colored rarity border or UI frame, no labels or text. All outside object and inside handle holes must be fully transparent ALPHA.

case_collectible_1.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this exact Rhodes Island storage case icon into the COLLECTIBLE storage case variant. Preserve the entire case silhouette, canvas construction, rigid frame, perspective, lighting, painted flat-color game icon style, charcoal-gray body, side Rhodes Island tower, and ONE central metal buckle. Change ONLY TWO design elements: (1) recolor the single wrapping strap from amber orange to rich GOLD YELLOW (visibly yellower than amber orange); (2) REPLACE the pale hex-bolt emblem on the FRONT panel with a clear small IVORY STATUETTE / bust figure emblem. The strap must read as light GOLD YELLOW, visibly yellower/brighter than orange, no amber orange remains. The emblem is a simple sculptural bust or small standing figurine silhouette, not a bolt. Keep all other body and frame colors unchanged. Exactly ONE isolated complete case, no new objects or contents. Final use 72x72. Maintain clear transparent margins and full handles/lid, no clipping. Output TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA outside case and in handle openings. No backdrop, floor, external shadow, UI border, label, text or watermark.
